chars.SAFA: SAFA: a young Moroccan woman wearing a bright red hoodie with a white stripe on each sleeve, black leggings and white sneakers, small gold hoop earrings.
chars.HIBA: HIBA: a young Moroccan woman wearing a mint-green satin blouse, light blue high-waist jeans, a beige shoulder bag and pink sandals.
chars.ADIL: ADIL: a young Moroccan man wearing a camel-brown leather jacket over a black t-shirt, dark grey chinos and a silver wristwatch.

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: A modern cafe terrace in Casablanca. In the center HIBA and ADIL sit at a table laughing together closely, while SAFA sits at the same table on the side, arms crossed, glaring at them with clear jealousy and anger.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: Night, a small Casablanca apartment bedroom lit by a lamp. SAFA sits on the edge of her bed scheming, chin on her hand, eyes narrowed with a sly evil look, phone glowing beside her.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: A shared apartment living room. HIBA happily packs an overnight bag on the sofa, excited and dreamy, while SAFA stands behind her in the doorway watching with a fake smile and suspicious eyes.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: Inside a clothing boutique in a Casablanca shopping mall. HIBA holds up an elegant red evening dress in front of herself, delighted, while SAFA beside her forces a tight fake smile.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: A street in Casablanca at dusk. ADIL proudly opens the door of his shiny black luxury car for HIBA, who is thrilled; in the background SAFA stands alone on the sidewalk, ignored, looking bitter.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: A small Moroccan apartment kitchen at night. SAFA stands at the counter with a sneaky grin, hiding something behind her back, glancing sideways toward the door.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: A small Moroccan apartment kitchen at night. SAFA secretly pours a white powder from a small plain unlabeled pharmacy box into a plate of food on the counter, looking over her shoulder nervously with a wicked grin.
